focuses.name: Defend
focuses.description: Prioritizes defensive shape, rest-defense security, and transition protection.
focuses.tacticalPurpose: Minimizes space exposed behind the player during turnovers.
focuses.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

focuses.name: Balanced
focuses.description: Adapts attacking and defensive involvement proportionally to ball position and game state.
focuses.tacticalPurpose: Provides measured two-way contribution without extreme positional commitment.
focuses.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

focuses.name: Attack
focuses.description: Commits aggressively forward into final-third spaces and box arrivals.
focuses.tacticalPurpose: Maximizes offensive threat and numerical presence around the penalty area.
focuses.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

focuses.name: Build-Up
focuses.description: Offers structured passing angles during early and middle-third ball progression.
focuses.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

focuses.name: Support
focuses.description: Operates close to teammates to create triangles, overlaps, and short passing combinations.
focuses.tacticalPurpose: Improves local numerical superiority and combination play.
focuses.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

focuses.name: Roaming
focuses.description: Permits vacating the starting zone to find open pockets across channels.
focuses.tacticalPurpose: Disrupts man-marking schemes and creates fluid overloads.
focuses.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

focuses.name: Aggressive
focuses.description: FC 26 update: steps proactively out of the line to press, intercept early, and contest duels tightly.
focuses.tacticalPurpose: Compresses time on the ball for opposing attackers at the risk of space behind.
focuses.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Gameplay Deep Dive Pitch Notes

focuses.name: Versatile
focuses.description: FC 26 update: reduces positional rigidity so the player adapts fluidly across phases and open spaces.
focuses.tacticalPurpose: Allows dynamic switching between support, width, and box-attacking behavior.
focuses.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Gameplay Deep Dive Pitch Notes

focuses.name: Ball-Winning
focuses.description: FC 26 update: tasks midfielders with proactively stepping in to win duels and intercept passes.
focuses.tacticalPurpose: Accelerates ball recovery in central zones.
focuses.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles

focuses.name: Wide
focuses.description: Drifts toward outer channels to stretch opposition central defenders.
focuses.tacticalPurpose: Pulls centre-backs wide and opens central lanes.
focuses.sourceReference: EA FC 26 Pitch Notes & FUTBIN Roles
